title: stats.json
description: What scripts/prepare.py found in the store it wrote (store_stats); scripts/slices_to_points.py refreshes molecules and molecule_genes. Written beside the store. Producers may add fields; readers ignore what they do not know.

input.description: What prepare.py recognised the input as: merscope, xenium, visium, h5ad, folder, …

store.description: The store's folder name, beside this file.

cells.description: Rows of the default table's X.

genes.description: Columns of the default table's X (blank and control probes already filtered).

molecules.description: Sum of points:n_points over the tiled points elements; 0 when there are none.

molecule_genes.description: Categories of the points feature column (may include blanks).

images.description: Names of the store's image elements, sorted.

de_stats.description: obs columns whose DE stats the table carries (uns/merfisheyes_de; varm/de_mean__<col>, varm/de_pct__<col>). Absent when the store has no table.

pipeline.description: Git short sha of the code that wrote the store.
